text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Shopping for daily necessities complete.

Returning to the academy to begin
preparations
for traini—

text_block_list.name: Sporting Goods Store Employee
text_block_list.text:
It's our grand reopening! Your efficiency
will go
through the roof with the latest
in our training
equipment! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Time remaining until training

begins—twenty-seven minutes, four
seconds... an
adequate amount of time
to verify the efficiency
of this
equipment.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... I detect a five-percent increase in stimulation of abdominal muscles over normal levels when using this machine...

text_block_list.name: Sporting Goods Store Employee
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for trying it out! Our next
product has a
proven ten-percent
increase!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Time remaining until training begins—ten

seconds. Calculating the best course of
action to
take.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Calculations complete. I have
determined that
continued testing may
increase my chances of
winning in the
future.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
As a result, I predict Father and Trainer
will be
pleased. Status—"cheerful."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
To achieve the best possible results, I
would like
to request a trial run of all
available equipment as
well as full data
disclosure!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon tries out everything in
the store
and ends up skipping her
training.
